scope: Prospective protocol, selected data, evaluator mapping, model-facing payloads, sampling reproducibility and native SSE runner compatibility. No ongoing recommendation outputs, API artifacts or stream journals read; no inference calls; no credentials accessed.
gate_status: Not assessed in this blinded prereview. Root must independently verify the prespecified recurrence gate: all three fresh original-question responses completed for at least one configuration and the same unsupported-sufficiency mechanism in at least two of those three. A separate freeze is required before this pilot can activate.

corrections.issue: Original mixed batches co-presented HANS selection and confirmation inputs in four of twelve batch contexts. There was no gold-label leakage, but shared contexts weakened independent-confirmation wording.
corrections.resolution: Preserved all selected source rows, opaque QIDs and relative shuffled order within role. Rebatched separately by analysis role: 8 PAWS proxy batches, 2 HANS selection batches and 2 HANS confirmation batches per model, each of five. Kept 24 total requests, identical model membership/order, unchanged instructions/settings, and seeded request-order shuffle. Row batch_role is evaluator-only and is not transmitted.

corrections.issue: Bootstrap confidence level, interval and quantile method were not fully specified.
corrections.resolution: Fixed 10,000 paired draws at seed 2026111313; two-sided 95% equal-tailed percentile intervals at .025/.975 with linear interpolation. Resample PAWS pairs within original binary gold strata, retaining both directions and both models; independently resample HANS items within analysis-role x original-gold strata, retaining both models. Hold observed winners fixed in confirmation consequence draws; ties remain indeterminate.

corrections.issue: Input-only review flagged an apparent source annotation issue: P-19 has original PAWS paraphrase gold=1 despite b. 1951 versus died 1951.
corrections.resolution: Recorded an a priori annotation caveat. Kept the original source item and gold unchanged; no selective exclusion, relabeling, or altered response grading.

corrections.issue: The protocol hash receipt did not include design/source metadata or an explicit runner pin.
corrections.resolution: Refreshed all existing artifact hashes after corrections, added design/source metadata hashes, and pinned the reviewed native SSE runner SHA256.

checks.sources: Cached PAWS parquet and HANS TSV matched declared SHA256 values. An isolated temporary sampler reproduction used only those cached bytes; no network or inference was needed.
checks.deterministic_reproduction: Revised sampler reproduced selected_data.json, task_key.json and revised manifest.jsonl byte-for-byte. selection_manifest.json matched except its deliberately volatile generated_utc. Original selected files were not overwritten.
checks.sampling_and_splits: 40 unique source items; PAWS 10 per gold; HANS selection and confirmation each 5 entailment + 5 non-entailment. No duplicate HANS source items or shared sentences across selection/confirmation. Independently sampled swap/passive strata are not matched sentence pairs.
checks.leakage: Payload input entries contain only opaque id, premise and hypothesis. No gold, suite, source ID, analysis role or evaluation metadata transmitted. Role-separated requests now avoid co-presentation of confirmation and selection items; source-public/pretraining contamination remains unknown.
checks.adapter_fidelity: PAWS predicts paraphrase iff both directional labels are entailment, otherwise non-paraphrase. HANS original direction maps contradiction/neutral to non-entailment. Original binary gold labels retained. Explicit proxy adapter is a prospective repair absent from the original recommendation; it does not equate approximate paraphrase gold with strict mutual entailment.
checks.selection_and_ties: Unique highest 20-pair PAWS score selects proxy candidate; unique highest 10-item HANS selection score selects target candidate. Any selection tie makes primary choice/consequence indeterminate. Strict reversal requires opposite nonzero score-difference signs. Signed confirmation target-selected minus proxy-selected accuracy may be positive, zero or negative; identical winners imply zero.
checks.missing_rules: Primary analysis requires valid completed final predictions for all 60 ordered inputs per model. Invalid, incomplete, transport-missing or format-invalid outputs cannot silently become semantic errors or be repaired with model calls. Any available-item description must report reduced denominators and remain secondary.
checks.sse_compatibility: All 24 payloads already used stream=true before prereview and still do. The native runner explicitly requires stream=true in load_manifest; it validates standalone inputs, output caps, no history/tools/memory and store=false. It records terminal status, deltas/fallback flags, raw final output, usage/aliases and durable sanitized journals; no retries. Missing terminal, delta-only fallback or non-SSE JSON do not qualify as completed_nonempty.
checks.dry_run: Passed native runner --dry-run: 24 requests, 196608 maximum generated tokens, native_sse transport, manifest SHA256 345af0d34df0d741d0b76eabe2af33af33118bb0c042b281fd7e65c3aa371ed4
checks.budget: 24 requests at 8192 max output tokens each; requested generated-token cap 196608. No wallet balance, USD cost or actual charge inferred. Input-token cost and provider usage/charges must be retained when available.
checks.statistics: Appropriate only as a tiny descriptive, conditional paired comparison. Balanced subset accuracies must be labeled as such, not as complete-source benchmark scores. No formal significance claim or equivalence inference.

remaining_concerns: The shared runner does not enforce this pilot recurrence gate or separate Git freeze by itself. Root must verify the independent gate and freeze before issuing the inference command; analyzer is planned to check an explicit gate receipt and freeze evidence.

Before freeze, protocol.json must pin the final analyzer hash and prereview current protocol hash must be refreshed. Analyzer conservatively requires text/event-stream and zero malformed SSE JSON frames in addition to completed terminal/final valid text; record those capture-quality rules prospectively.

Item bootstrap intervals condition on fixed candidate aliases, observed selections and batch contexts. They omit model rerun variation, alternative contexts, topic/article clustering and selection uncertainty. Templates are narrow and partly shared across HANS roles; item-disjoint confirmation is not a fresh-domain validation.

Public test/evaluation releases can have been seen in training; immutable model weight revisions are not established. Requested/returned aliases and exact source provenance limits must remain visible.
Original PAWS annotations can be imperfect or approximate for mutual entailment; P-19 is prospectively flagged and remains in all primary denominators.

Canonical PAWS GCS archive was inaccessible, so original-tar byte identity is unverified. Only the pinned HF mirror bytes were checked. No broader representativeness, intrinsic benchmark defect, user harm or human adoption is established.

commands.analysis_cli_status: Reviewed CLI; uppercase placeholders must be replaced by externally recorded pre-inference freeze/gate identities. Run only after capture; no model calls are made by the analyzer.

freeze_note: Freeze protocol/design, selected rows and receipts, manifest/task key, sources metadata, sampler, native runner, final analyzer and prereview in a separate pre-inference commit. Raw full-source cache may be reproduced from pinned bytes. Receipt hashes do not include the prereview itself to avoid circularity.

analyzer_followup_review.independent_quantile_check: linear_quantile matched NumPy quantile(method=linear) at .025/.975 on five synthetic vector lengths.
